pages.title: The Ridge's own
text: The moonstone heights of the [Glimmer Ridge](glimmer_ridge) keep a crested grazer and a moth in the open, and a grub and a stalker in the caves below.

Every gentle beast here can be brushed for its reagent once a minute, and is tempted and bred with its own food, named under **Hunting and herding** below. It can be bonded like any gentle animal (see [familiars](familiars)), though none of them has a familiar gift of its own.

pages.title: Prism Grazer
text: A scaled, crested grazer, in herds of two to four. **24 health** and **3 armour**.
It drops **1 to 3 Prism Crests**, more with Looting.

pages.title: Shardmoth
text: A violet moth that flutters over the ridge in ones to threes. **10 health**, no armour.

pages.title: Glowgrub
text: A long, segmented grub of the dark caves under the ridge, one to three at a time. **18 health** and **1 armour**. It is gentle, and flees from monsters like any grazer.

pages.title: Facet Stalker
text: A stilt-legged hunter of the same caves. It rises in the dark there day or night, one to three at a time. It has **21 health** and **1 armour**, is quick, and its sting does **5** and poisons you for 3 seconds.
It drops **1 to 2 Facet Barbs**, a Venom reagent.

pages.title: Hunting and herding
text: Besides its reagent, each one drops more when hunted, and more again with Looting. Meat drops roasted if the animal died burning. To breed wild ones, **sneak** while you feed two adults their food; fed normally, a wild one warms to you instead.
- **Prism Grazer**: 1 to 2 Raw Game and up to 1 March Leather. Breed with **Glimmer Beans**.
- **Shardmoth**: up to 1 String and up to 1 Amethyst Shard. Breed with **Glimmer Beans**.
- **Glowgrub**: up to 2 Glowstone Dust. Breed with **Lantern Caps or any mushroom**.
- **Facet Stalker**: up to 1 Amethyst Shard and up to 1 String.
